findings.pattern_name: std::set / std::map with pointer key, default comparator
findings.title: Address-ordered driver sets drive mutating pre-opt restructuring
findings.description_md: `ctoFlow::restructFlow()` collects LP and non-LP driver candidates in `std::set<ndmTerm*>` with default `std::less<ndmTerm*>` (raw addresses). Both sets are iterated to call `cloneBufferInverter()` / `bufShieldBufferInverter()`. Accepted transforms mutate netlist/timing state seen by later drivers. The non-LP loop also early-exits after ~10% of max tree size, so visit order selects which drivers are even attempted.
findings.downstream_observability_md: Suspect: pointer-address set order. Caller: `ctoFlow::restructFlow()` pre-opt. Sink: sequential clone/shield mutations + early-break quota. Observable on CTO pre-opt QoR and downstream CTS topology.
findings.controls_md: CTO pre-opt restructuring (`restructFlow`); `_preOptRestructMode = true`. Requires LP/non-LP buffer/inverter drivers collected from clock-tree scan.

findings.title: Distance-only node sort ties pick arbitrary load for 1/4 repeater anchor
findings.description_md: `termDistances` holds `node` wrappers around `ndmTerm*`. `std::sort` uses distance-only `node::operator<`. Equal-distance loads get unspecified relative order. Odd-fanout path picks the first sorted load as `load1` for `instantiateRepeater` at 1/4 distance.
findings.downstream_observability_md: Sorted order selects which sink anchors the first repeater and its placement coordinate → MSCTS tap subtree topology / latency / skew.
findings.controls_md: MSCTS multisource tap subtree synthesis when a driver fanout group has odd load count and ≥2 loads share equal driver distance.

findings.title: SP sink min_element lacks term-ID tie-break on equal delays
findings.description_md: `std::min_element` on `_sinks` (`ndmTerm*`) compares early/late delays but returns false on full ties, so the first equal-delay sink in `_sinks` wins. That index (`_spSinkPos`) gates binary partition inclusion.
findings.downstream_observability_md: `_spSinkPos` feeds `appendBinaryPartitions` / include-SP paths → buffered-load partitions and MTCTO GLS buffering QoR.
findings.controls_md: MTCTO load partitioning when ≥2 sinks share identical early/late delays at the representative sclk/corner.

module_specific_summary_md: CTS (local `C:\\Users\\carys\\cts`, ~2391 C++ files) is largely ND-aware: many sites already use `ndmObjPtrCmpType` / project wrappers, and prior MT prove-nd work classified the main concurrent hotspots as latent, neutralized, or unreachable. The confirmed defect surface for HIGH/MEDIUM is concentrated in CTO pre-opt restructuring (address-ordered mutating driver sets) and MSCTS/MTCTO tie-break gaps on equal-distance or equal-delay selections. Random/time seeds, filesystem iteration, and most unordered_*/hash hits did not survive downstream-observability proof under production controls.
